easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Justiciar's Portal.
description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and giving it first strike until end of turn, and putting Justiciar's Portal into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Justiciar's Portal to your hand.
Repeat.
